# apple_app_store_version_experiment (Resource)

Defines a product page optimization test: an experiment that shows up to three treatments, created with `apple_app_store_version_experiment_treatment`, to a share of the people who visit an app's product page. An app has one experiment at a time per platform. Submit it with the `apple_submit_app_store_version_experiment` action when it needs review, start and stop it with the `apple_start_app_store_version_experiment` and `apple_stop_app_store_version_experiment` actions, and apply a treatment to the product page with `apple_promote_app_store_version_experiment_treatment`. An experiment can't change once it has started. Destroying the resource deletes the experiment. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_store_version_experiment" "icons" {
  app_id             = data.apple_app.example.id
  platform           = "IOS"
  name               = "Spring icon color test"
  traffic_proportion = 40
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the test, up to 64 characters.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the product page: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`.
- `traffic_proportion` (Number) Percentage of visitors who see a treatment instead of the original product page, from 1 to 100. The treatments share it equally.

### Read-Only

- `end_date` (String) When the experiment ended.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment.
- `review_required` (Boolean) Whether App Review must review the experiment before it can start.
- `start_date` (String) When the experiment started.
- `state` (String) State of the experiment: `PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION`, `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW`, `IN_REVIEW`, `ACCEPTED`, `APPROVED`, `REJECTED`, `COMPLETED`, `STOPPED`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_store_version_experiment.icons
  identity = {
    id = "1a22d9a7-f574-4669-b1ca-1ba88f786c19"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the experiment.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_app_store_version_experiment.icons 1a22d9a7-f574-4669-b1ca-1ba88f786c19
```
